item.title: Inraku Relaxation ~Hosoi Yubisaki no Technique~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ater
  • 発売日: 2016-12-22
  • スコア: 5.8/10 (22 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 淫楽リラクゼーション ～細い指先のテクニック～
  • 英語名: Inraku Relaxation Hosoi Yubisaki no Technique

あらすじ

To relieve the fatigue of his daily transportation job… Our protagonist, Arata Satoru, frequents ear cleaning and massage parlors.

One day, he hurts his back at work and heads to a new place for the first time to seek help. He walks into a parlor called “Anriru” without doing his research… and it turns out to be a slightly erotic and unusual beauty parlor. And it seems…if the girls like you, they’ll provide you with any kind of service.
